hazards.description: The wide, open asphalt without lane narrowing or traffic calming encourages higher vehicle speeds in a residential zone.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible to facilitate safe movement between residential buildings on opposite sides of the street.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The excessive width of the travel lanes encourages higher vehicle speeds, as evidenced by tire marks on the pavement.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian-Vehicle Separation
hazards.description: The paved area in front of the buildings lacks markings or physical barriers to distinguish the pedestrian path from the vehicle driveway and parking lot.
hazards.location_in_image: Paved area in front of the 'Collision' building

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks any marked pedestrian crossings, increasing risk for those trying to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the image

hazards.name: Wide Curb Cuts
hazards.description: The large paved apron on the left allows vehicles to enter and exit at various points, creating unpredictable conflict zones with pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no dedicated, separated sidewalks visible on either side of the street, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Excessive Road Width
hazards.description: The wide, undivided roadway lacks traffic calming and likely encourages vehicle speeds that are unsafe for a residential area without pedestrian infrastructure.

hazards.name: Frequent Driveway Conflicts
hazards.description: Multiple driveways cross the sidewalk, creating frequent conflict points between pedestrians and vehicles entering or exiting properties.

hazards.name: Wide roadway geometry
hazards.description: The wide, straight lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential context.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parallel parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the sightlines of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street along the curb

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large parked vehicles, specifically the black pickup truck, block sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Vehicle Access
hazards.description: Large paved aprons for commercial use create wide, undefined conflict zones where vehicles may cross pedestrian paths unpredictably.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image in front of the commercial building

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings and the overall width of the asphalt encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs visible along this stretch of road.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side may block the view of pedestrians for drivers exiting driveways or turning.
hazards.location_in_image: Parked car on the right side of the road.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: The large SUV parked at the curb obscures the view of pedestrians, particularly children, who might attempt to cross the street from behind it.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, right side of the image.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The roadway is very wide with no mid-block crossings or refuge islands, forcing pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic unprotected.

hazards.name: Lack of Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks, which reduces driver awareness of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Walkways
hazards.description: There are no paved sidewalks on either side of the road, forcing pedestrians to walk on the shoulder or in traffic lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible area.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane road lacks any midblock crossing or refuge island, making it dangerous for residents to cross between homes and apartments.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes without traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds in a residential area.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Long Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a standard-width sidewalk on the left side of the street to ensure a continuous pedestrian network.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with curb ramps to provide safe crossing points between residential and commercial areas.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk with a raised curb to provide physical separation between pedestrians and vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the number and width of driveways to minimize conflict points and improve the continuity of the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks with ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or curb extensions to reduce vehicle speeds and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway to the minimum necessary for vehicle access, restoring the curb and sidewalk to shorten the pedestrian exposure zone.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Carry the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to signal to drivers that they are crossing a pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Signage Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate large signs and restrict parking near the driveway throat to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add a buffer zone with street trees between the new sidewalk and the roadway to improve pedestrian comfort and visually narrow the street.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing / Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes using paint or physical barriers to slow traffic and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to protect pedestrians from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the commercial driveway to the minimum required for safe vehicle access to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Paving
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority and encourage slower vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the roadway and the walkway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Reduce the effective width of the roadway through lane narrowing or curb extensions to slow traffic and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to provide designated and safer crossing points for residents.

interventions.title: Speed humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to physically slow traffic to speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Installation
interventions.description: Install raised curbs to physically separate the pedestrian realm from the vehicle travel lanes and manage drainage.

interventions.title: Parking Restrictions
interventions.description: Implement 'no parking' zones near conflict points to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add clear lane markings and potentially bike lanes or a center turn lane to narrow the travel lanes and reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Implement on-street bike lanes to narrow the travel lanes, which can help reduce vehicle speeds and provide an additional buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a buffer and create a sense of enclosure that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Marking
interventions.description: Clearly mark the sidewalk across the driveway with high-visibility paint or different materials to reinforce pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reconfigure the roadway to reduce the number of through lanes or narrow them, providing space for sidewalks and reducing vehicle speeds.
